name: Disable Lock Screen Fun Facts
description: Removes fun facts and tips from the lock screen to reduce distractions during sign-in.

description_i18n.en: Removes fun facts and tips from the lock screen to reduce distractions during sign-in.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt Fun Facts und Tipps vom Sperrbildschirm, um Ablenkungen während der Anmeldung zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les anecdotes et conseils de l'écran de verrouillage pour réduire les distractions lors de la connexion.

warnings.title: User Scope Limitation
warnings.message: This tweak only affects the current user. Windows updates or organization policies may restore lock screen content behavior on some systems

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the ContentDeliveryManager registry key under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion to set RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled and SubscribedContent-338387Enabled values
